# ECDLPResource17.GateDepth

**GateDepth**

实际primitive gateword计数与zero-duration Clifford依赖传播。

**边界**：PDF pp19–20. CNOT/NOT have zero Toffoli duration but dependencies must still propagate maximum readiness across their touched wires. Ignoring all counter updates is not generally a correct depth scheduler.

**覆盖等级**：D
